verdict_text:
YES

The script loads all three checkpoints, checks identical key sets, verifies bit-exact equality of every non-MLP tensor against both fine-tunes before any mutation, then computes each of the 48 MLP tensors in float32 from the *unmodified* base (`b` is always `base[name]`, never an updated value), copies the remaining 66 tensors from the base unchanged, asserts `merged == 48` and `len(out) == 114`, and writes a single `out/T4/model.safetensors`.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
